title: Application ServiceDiscovery ZooKeeper Entity
description: ZooKeeper-specific configuration. Extends Application/ServiceDiscovery with ZooKeeper-specific settings.

tick_time.description: Length of a single tick in milliseconds (basic time unit).

init_limit.description: Number of ticks allowed for initial synchronization.

sync_limit.description: Number of ticks allowed for followers to sync with the leader.

max_client_cnxns.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections per IP.

autopurge.description: Automatic purge configuration for transaction logs and snapshots.

purge_interval.description: Purge interval in hours (0 to disable).
